summary: Lucid Group filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $550M private placement of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock to Ayar Third Investment Company, an affiliate of PIF, its majority shareholder. The transaction involved 55,000 shares at $10,000 per share. No premium is applicable as this is a negotiated private placement, not a public offer. The board did not issue a recommendation; the transaction was exempt under Section 4(a)(2). The shares are convertible into Class A common stock with registration rights under the Seventh IRA Amendment. This is a capital raising event, not a special situation transaction, so no risk-arb angle exists.
